invalid.name: definition_carries_substitution_policy
invalid.reason: The definition stores no substitution policy that could let a stand-in start; an unavailable chosen model blocks Start (CWR-032, CWR-034).

invalid.name: definition_crew_missing_shared_notes
invalid.reason: Shared notes replace shared versus private scratch for a Crew and are written into its definition (CWR-032, section 5.2).

invalid.name: definition_crew_shared_notes_value_open
invalid.reason: shared_notes_policy is closed to shared_space and private_per_participant (CWR-032).

invalid.name: definition_review_with_specialist
invalid.rejects_for: review participant_specs must be core (additive_role_kind none)
invalid.reason: Review has no specialists (CWR-028).

invalid.name: definition_review_carries_hard_constraints
invalid.rejects_for: kind fields appear only on their kind
invalid.reason: hard_constraints[] is a BrainStorm field (CWR-027, CWR-032); a Review definition never carries it.

invalid.name: definition_chat_room_missing_summary_style
invalid.reason: The Chat Room Advanced page writes moderator_style, mention_policy, stop_condition and summary_style (CWR-024).

invalid.name: definition_brainstorm_provisioning_install_always
invalid.reason: provisioning_posture is closed to ask_first and never_install; a run never installs research tools without the approval path (CWR-027, section 8.2).

invalid.name: definition_brainstorm_constraint_without_source
invalid.rejects_for: hard_constraint requires id, text and source
invalid.reason: Each must-have is {id, text, source} (CWR-027).

invalid.name: definition_grill_me_with_persona
invalid.reason: Grill Me is a methodology Skill and never a Persona, so its row has no Persona (DL-133, CWR-028).

invalid.name: definition_wonderer_without_own_model
invalid.rejects_for: specialist spec requires its own requested_model_id
invalid.reason: An added specialist is its own row with its own model picker (CWR-028).

invalid.name: definition_coordinator_slot_without_slot_id
invalid.reason: participant_slot names one of the run's participant slots (CWR-037).

invalid.name: definition_parent_assistant_with_model
invalid.rejects_for: coordinator_spec parent_assistant carries no requested identity
invalid.reason: parent_assistant is this chat's assistant; only dedicated_model adds its own requested identity (CWR-037).

invalid.name: definition_coordinator_kind_open
invalid.reason: coordinator_spec kind is closed to parent_assistant, participant_slot and dedicated_model (CWR-037).

invalid.name: run_crew_auto_without_revision
invalid.reason: A run admitted by Crew Auto records the revision of the rules that admitted it, so the card can say which rules started it (CWR-021).

invalid.name: run_user_with_crew_auto_revision
invalid.rejects_for: crew_auto_revision only on a crew_auto admission
invalid.reason: crew_auto_revision names the Crew Auto configuration that admitted the run; a user start was not admitted by it (CWR-021).

invalid.name: run_build_with_crew_without_plan
invalid.reason: The Build With Crew transaction binds assistant_plan_id and plan_version (CWR-023, section 5.4).

invalid.name: run_admission_source_open
invalid.reason: admission_source is closed to user, crew_auto, build_with_crew and scheduled_build (CWR-021).

invalid.name: run_state_open
invalid.reason: Run states are closed; a bare Working state is not one of them (section 2.1).

invalid.name: run_cancelled_without_stop_reason
invalid.rejects_for: stop_reason required on a cancelled run
invalid.reason: stop_reason is set on every cancelled run (CWR-029, DL-131).

invalid.name: run_running_with_stop_reason
invalid.rejects_for: stop_reason only on a cancelled run
invalid.reason: stop_reason is set on a cancelled run and on no other (CWR-029, section 12).

invalid.name: run_limit_stop_settles_failed
invalid.rejects_for: stop_reason only on a cancelled run (a limit stop never settles failed)
invalid.reason: A run that reaches its own limit settles cancelled, never failed, and gets no new run state (CWR-029, DL-131).

invalid.name: run_stop_reason_open
invalid.reason: stop_reason is closed to user_cancel, limit_time, limit_cost and limit_tokens; reaching a limit is a stop reason, not an attention reason (CWR-029).

invalid.name: message_sender_kind_open
invalid.reason: sender_kind is closed to user, participant, coordinator and system (section 2.3).

invalid.name: vote_position_majority
invalid.reason: A vote records support, oppose or abstain; there is no majority-weight value (section 8.5, CWR-027).

invalid.name: target_pack_without_hash
invalid.reason: A frozen pack records the exact hashes every reviewer read (section 7.2).

invalid.name: target_pack_kind_open
invalid.reason: target_kind is closed to the six target kinds of section 7.2.

invalid.name: finding_without_origin
invalid.reason: Normalization never loses an originating reviewer identity (section 7.5).

invalid.name: finding_severity_as_disposition
invalid.reason: Severity and disposition are separate axes; confirmed is not a severity (section 7.5).

invalid.name: disposition_waiver_without_reason
invalid.rejects_for: waiver requires actor, reason and currentness
invalid.reason: A waiver identifies actor, reason and currentness (PART-001..006, CWR-024).

invalid.name: disposition_waived_without_waiver
invalid.reason: Continue without is an explicit waiver; a slot is never waived silently (CWR-024, PART-001..006).

invalid.name: disposition_completed_with_waiver
invalid.reason: A waiver is recorded only by the explicit waive action (PART-001..006).

invalid.name: disposition_unavailable_claims_attempt
invalid.reason: Configuration alone never creates a runtime participant, and no provider attempt is claimed (PART-021..024, CWR-034).

invalid.name: completion_clean_with_attention
invalid.reason: A clean result and a Needs attention face never coexist; both read only this projection (CWR-029).

invalid.name: completion_limit_reached_reason
invalid.reason: attention_reason is closed to six values; reaching a limit is a stop reason, not an attention reason (CWR-029, DL-131).

invalid.name: completion_partial_review_on_crew
invalid.rejects_for: partial_review applies to a Review only
invalid.reason: Partial coverage is a Review outcome (PART-007..010, CWR-026).

invalid.name: completion_accept_partial_on_run_again
invalid.reason: accept_partial is an explicit waiver through cmd.collaboration.reconfigure (CWR-026).

invalid.name: completion_restart_on_reconfigure
invalid.reason: restart_on_current is cmd.review.run_again against a newly frozen pack (CWR-026).

invalid.name: completion_action_invented_command
invalid.rejects_for: allowed_actions map to existing commands only
invalid.reason: Each allowed action maps to one existing command; no per-workflow retry command is minted (CWR-029, PART-001..006).

invalid.name: activity_needs_you_without_decision
invalid.reason: needs_you carries the decision it waits on (CWR-030).

invalid.name: activity_decision_ref_on_working
invalid.reason: Only a pending decision makes a participant needs_you (CWR-030).

invalid.name: activity_persisted_flag
invalid.reason: The projection is derived on read and never persisted or replayed (CWR-030).

invalid.name: activity_state_streaming
invalid.reason: Verbs change at state boundaries and tool events, never per token; streaming is not a presentation state (CWR-030).

invalid.name: activity_carries_streamed_text
invalid.rejects_for: additionalProperties false (the projection never holds streamed text)
invalid.reason: live_message_id only points at the message in progress; the projection never holds the streamed text (CWR-030, DL-137).

patch.live_text: Streaming the rows to a CSV

invalid.name: activity_done_keeps_live_message
invalid.reason: live_message_id is absent once the message is written; the settled lane quotes it through quote_source_id (CWR-030, EP-130).

invalid.name: activity_failed_keeps_live_message
invalid.reason: A message in progress whose attempt fails is discarded and leaves the lane, so live_message_id is absent (CWR-030, EP-131).

invalid.name: in_progress_user_sender
invalid.rejects_for: helper stream sender_kind closed to participant and coordinator
invalid.reason: User messages never stream; only a participant or the coordinator writes a message in progress (EP-129).

invalid.name: in_progress_system_sender
invalid.rejects_for: helper stream sender_kind closed to participant and coordinator
invalid.reason: System messages never stream; only a participant or the coordinator writes a message in progress (EP-129).

invalid.name: in_progress_participant_without_attempt
invalid.rejects_for: participant message in progress requires attempt_id
invalid.reason: A participant's message in progress is bound to the attempt that is writing it, so a retry streams under a new id (EP-129, EP-131).

invalid.name: in_progress_participant_without_slot
invalid.rejects_for: participant message in progress requires participant_slot_id
invalid.reason: A participant's message in progress is shown only in its own slot's lane (EP-129, CWR-040).

invalid.name: in_progress_carries_text
invalid.rejects_for: additionalProperties false (no partial text becomes a record)
invalid.reason: The streamed text is presentation of a message in progress, never a second record; no partial text is persisted (EP-130, DL-137).

patch.partial_text: Streaming the rows to a CSV

invalid.name: in_progress_carries_sequence
invalid.rejects_for: additionalProperties false (sequence is assigned at the write)
invalid.reason: A message in progress has no sequence; the sequence is assigned when the one CollaborationMessage is written (EP-130).

invalid.name: in_progress_carries_recipients
invalid.rejects_for: additionalProperties false (no participant receives a message in progress)
invalid.reason: Only the user sees a message in progress; participants receive the message only once it is written (EP-129, EP-130).

invalid.name: preset_grill_me_as_persona
invalid.rejects_for: grill_me preset row forbids a Persona
invalid.reason: A preset adds Grill Me only as a specialist row, never as a Persona (CWR-039, DL-133).

invalid.name: configure_result_starts_run
invalid.rejects_for: additionalProperties false (configure carries no run identity)
invalid.reason: cmd.collaboration.configure validates and previews only; it never starts a run (MODAL-003..005).

invalid.name: configure_blocker_substituted
invalid.reason: A blocked row names the owner's typed reason; there is no substituted outcome (CWR-034).

invalid.name: start_request_build_with_crew
invalid.reason: Build With Crew dispatches cmd.chat.plan.build_with_crew and never cmd.collaboration.start (CWR-022, MODAL-013..014).

invalid.name: start_request_review_without_target
invalid.reason: Review target identity and hash freeze at Start (MODAL-009..010).

invalid.name: start_request_review_target_silent_swap
invalid.reason: The user chooses the current version or the version the sheet opened with; there is no silent swap (MODAL-009..010, CWR-025).

invalid.name: start_request_crew_auto_without_revision
invalid.reason: A Crew Auto admission names the committed configuration revision that admitted it (CWR-021).

invalid.name: start_request_without_idempotency
invalid.reason: Every asynchronous start is idempotent: a double invocation returns the original run (section 2.6, MODAL-015..018).

invalid.name: start_result_committed_without_run
invalid.reason: A committed start returns run identity (section 10).

invalid.name: start_result_refused_with_run
invalid.rejects_for: refused start carries no run identity
invalid.reason: A failed Start creates no card and no partial participant records (MODAL-003..005).

invalid.name: start_result_refused_without_error
invalid.rejects_for: not committed requires a typed error
invalid.reason: A failure carries its typed error and never a success shape (section 11).

invalid.name: start_result_refused_with_work
invalid.rejects_for: not committed carries no observable work
invalid.reason: A refusal claims no provider attempt or work (PART-021..024, section 11).

invalid.name: start_result_error_open
invalid.reason: Errors come from the closed section 11 enumeration.

invalid.name: pause_result_completed
invalid.reason: Pause reaches a safe boundary and returns exact run state (section 2.6).

invalid.name: resume_result_second_state
invalid.reason: Resume continues the same run; it never reports paused or a terminal state (section 10).

invalid.name: cancel_result_without_receipt
invalid.rejects_for: committed cancel requires a cancellation receipt
invalid.reason: Cancel records a cancellation receipt (section 2.6).

invalid.name: cancel_request_without_currentness
invalid.reason: Mutations on a run revalidate currentness before dispatch (section 11).

invalid.name: message_request_delivery_interrupt
invalid.rejects_for: delivery_mode closed to queue and steer
invalid.reason: A mid-round message steers without interrupting; no turn is cancelled and the round is not restarted (CWR-024, DL-112).

invalid.name: message_request_without_generation
invalid.reason: Destination state_generation is revalidated before dispatch (section 10).

invalid.name: message_result_refused_writes_message
invalid.reason: A message to a finished run is unavailable and writes nothing (CWR-031).

invalid.name: open_request_target_panel
invalid.reason: The full panel is now the run view; target is closed to card, run_view and activity_detail (CWR-020, CWR-031).

invalid.name: open_request_focus_two_kinds
invalid.rejects_for: focus names exactly one of tab, participant_id or finding_id
invalid.reason: The optional focus names a tab, a participant or a finding (CWR-031).

invalid.name: open_result_panel_document
invalid.rejects_for: run_view document_id carries a kind prefix
invalid.reason: The run view is one editor document per run with a stable kind-prefixed id (CWR-020).

invalid.name: open_result_run_view_without_document
invalid.reason: Opening the run view focuses or opens its one editor document (CWR-020).

invalid.name: open_result_changes_run_state
invalid.rejects_for: additionalProperties false (navigation carries no run state)
invalid.reason: Route success is not run success; open cannot mutate a run (section 10).

invalid.name: open_result_failed_without_error
invalid.rejects_for: route_ok false requires a typed error
invalid.reason: A failed route names its reason (section 11).

invalid.name: export_request_content_kind_open
invalid.reason: content_kind is closed to transcript, result_artifact and report (CWR-031).

invalid.name: export_request_without_hash
invalid.reason: Export ships the referenced version and hash and never re-renders (section 10).

invalid.name: reconfigure_request_empty
invalid.reason: A reconfiguration names what it changes; only finish_stale needs no participant change (CWR-026, CWR-031).

invalid.name: reconfigure_waiver_without_reason
invalid.reason: Continue without is an explicit waiver that identifies its reason (CWR-024, PART-001..006).

invalid.name: reconfigure_add_participant_as_wonderer
invalid.reason: Adding Grill Me mid-run adds a Grill Me row; it never repurposes the change for another role (CWR-031).

invalid.name: reconfigure_silent_substitute
invalid.reason: No participant is swapped silently; replacement names the slot and the new requested identity (PART-001..006).

invalid.name: reconfigure_result_completed
invalid.rejects_for: committed reconfigure leaves a non-terminal run
invalid.reason: Reconfigure is available only while the run is waiting, running, blocked or paused; a completed run is never reconfigured (CWR-031).

invalid.name: reconfigure_result_without_system_entry
invalid.rejects_for: committed reconfigure records a system transcript entry
invalid.reason: Reconfiguration records a system transcript entry (section 6.3, CWR-024).

invalid.name: brainstorm_round_phase_open
invalid.rejects_for: phase closed to the seven phases
invalid.reason: BrainStorm runs seven ordered phases (section 8.5, CWR-027).

invalid.name: synthesis_tie_first_response
invalid.reason: Ties are never broken by first response, provider order or model prestige (PART-011..015, CWR-027).

invalid.name: plan_create_result_without_plan
invalid.rejects_for: committed synthesis returns exactly one Plan
invalid.reason: BrainStorm always ends in exactly one Plan (section 8.1).

invalid.name: lead_substantiated_without_evidence
invalid.reason: A lead is never accepted as fact without evidence (section 9.2, CWR-031).

invalid.name: lead_set_aside_without_reason
invalid.reason: The result records the reason the lead was set aside (CWR-031).

invalid.name: lead_hypothesis_with_evidence
invalid.reason: Evidence makes a lead substantiated; a hypothesis carries none (section 9.2).

invalid.name: create_todos_implicit_selection
invalid.reason: Only the final explicit selection is converted (CWR-026).

invalid.name: create_todos_without_lineage
invalid.reason: Each To-Do keeps lineage back to its finding (section 7.6).

invalid.name: composer_buffer_sends
invalid.reason: Send Findings fills the box and never sends; nothing runs until the user presses Send (DL-125).

invalid.name: composer_buffer_without_lineage
invalid.reason: The findings' lineage is recorded in message metadata, never in the text (CWR-031).

invalid.name: composer_buffer_overwrites
invalid.reason: A composer that holds text refuses with composer_not_empty and is not overwritten (CWR-031).

invalid.name: room_summary_creates_todo
invalid.reason: Summarize creates no To-Do, Plan or Goal (section 10).

invalid.name: promote_without_message_lineage
invalid.reason: Promotion preserves lineage to the exact message and participant (section 6.4).

invalid.name: promote_rejected_creates_plan
invalid.reason: The Plan owner admits or rejects; a rejection creates no Plan (section 6.4).

invalid.name: promote_rejected_without_reason
invalid.rejects_for: rejected promotion names the owner reason
invalid.reason: The owner's refusal is carried, never hidden (section 6.4).

invalid.name: room_end_settles_cancelled
invalid.reason: End discussion settles completed, never cancelled; it is distinct from cmd.collaboration.cancel (CWR-031, DL-130).

invalid.name: room_end_blocks_promotion
invalid.reason: Promotion of the room's existing messages stays allowed after End discussion (CWR-024).

invalid.name: crew_auto_enable_without_team
invalid.rejects_for: scope project requires rules and team in the same request
invalid.reason: One click, one command: the Crew Auto sheet's primary commits the rules and the team together (CWR-038).

invalid.name: crew_auto_team_with_specialist
invalid.rejects_for: Crew Auto team members are core only
invalid.reason: Specialists are refused in Crew Auto teams (CWR-028).

invalid.name: crew_auto_set_without_scope
invalid.reason: CrewAutoSetRequest names its scope (CWR-038, DL-120).

invalid.name: crew_auto_scope_open
invalid.rejects_for: scope closed to project and thread
invalid.reason: CrewAutoSetRequest scope is closed as project | thread (CWR-038).

invalid.name: crew_auto_thread_carries_rules
invalid.rejects_for: scope thread carries no rules or team
invalid.reason: A chat's check sets only that chat's override of the project value; the rules and the team are committed only from the Crew Auto sheet (CWR-038).

invalid.name: crew_auto_thread_from_sheet
invalid.rejects_for: scope thread is sent from a chat's check (multi_agent_menu)
invalid.reason: The Crew Auto sheet's primary sends project; a chat's Crew Auto check sends thread (CWR-038).

invalid.name: crew_auto_project_from_check
invalid.rejects_for: scope project is sent from the Crew Auto sheet (crew_auto_modal)
invalid.reason: A chat's check never changes the project value; only the Crew Auto sheet's primary sends project (CWR-038).

invalid.name: crew_auto_thread_claims_settings_transaction
invalid.rejects_for: scope thread is not a project Settings transaction
invalid.reason: A chat's Crew Auto check sets only that chat's override and is not a project Settings transaction (CWR-038, MODAL-006..008).

invalid.name: crew_auto_parts_four
invalid.reason: The minimum number of parts that can run at the same time is 2 or 3 (CWR-021).

invalid.name: crew_auto_on_without_settings_commit
invalid.rejects_for: scope project enabled_after true requires a Settings transaction
invalid.reason: Turning Crew Auto on for the project succeeds only after a committed configuration and a successful project Settings commit (MODAL-006..008, CWR-038).

invalid.name: crew_auto_refused_with_transaction
invalid.reason: Cancel or refusal preserves the prior state; optimistic enabling is prohibited (MODAL-006..008).

invalid.name: crew_auto_route_surface_open
invalid.rejects_for: open_config surfaces closed to multi_agent_menu, workflow_modal and crew_auto_receipt
invalid.reason: cmd.chat.crew_auto.open_config is dispatched from the multi-agent menu, the Crew sheet and the Crew Auto note's Change control (section 10, CWR-038).

invalid.name: crew_auto_route_enables
invalid.reason: Route success is not enablement; the check changes only through cmd.chat.crew_auto.set (CWR-038).
